name: locale-demo
title: Locale demo
description: Show localisation instead of claiming it: pick a language and the same price, date, number and plural change shape live.
docs: Pass title, a sample (amount and currency, an ISO date, a count and, if you like, a number and a number of days) and optionally description, locales (a code and a label each), defaultLocale and timeZone. English, Dutch, German, Japanese and Arabic are built in, with the card's own words; for another language pass messages with its locale. Every value is made by Intl (NumberFormat, DateTimeFormat in the time zone you give, RelativeTimeFormat and PluralRules) and shown with the raw value it came from, as a caption under it. The card turns around for languages written from right to left, the switch wraps into evenly sized rows on a phone, and it is announced as "Showing Deutsch". locale and onLocaleChange control it from outside.
